remarks: "Welcome to 218 Knickerbocker Avenue. A beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath colonial nestled in the highly sought-after Springdale section of Stamford. This move-in ready home has been freshly painted and is ready for its new owner. Commuters will love the location. Just a six-minute walk to Springdale's Metro-North station, with an easy hour ride straight into Grand Central.The first level offers a bright, sun-filled flow with formal living and dining rooms, perfect for entertaining, plus sliders leading out to a large deck overlooking the beautifully landscaped, fully fenced backyard. Enjoy long afternoons outdoors surrounded by well-manicured lawn and stunning perennials, a true oasis for relaxing or hosting guests, with the privacy of your own yard and entrance. Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms with gleaming hardwood floors, along with a full bath featuring double sinks. Hardwood floors extend throughout the home, complemented by a kitchen appointed with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The home shares a double-wide driveway with the neighboring property, offering ample room to access the one-car garage, which is currently set up as a home gym, but easily converted back to parking or storage. Also featuring a dry, solid basement plus a spacious attic, offering abundant storage or future potential. Set on a walkable street within easy reach of Springdale Elementary School, along with nearby shopping and dining. Go see it today!
